scope: Native comparison for decoded MySQL index names and the columns they name. The system identifier comparison is fixed independently of connection data collation and exact table/database names.
identityKeys: Apply the stock utf8 general lowercase table to each valid BMP scalar. The selected names admit no NUL, surrogates or supplementary scalar. Retain exact declared spelling and never erase accents.

exhaustion.order: Ascending scalar from U+0001 through U+FFFF excluding U+D800 through U+DFFF.
exhaustion.mappingEncoding: UTF-8 compact JSON object in scalar order containing only changed pairs and literal Unicode.
exhaustion.conditions: Require live pinned releases, each exact point, system utf8 charset, no scalar omission or duplicate, exact output byte sequences, and the distributed PHP case function over every point.

nativeControls: CREATE INDEX with the spelling PRİMARY resolves the reserved key role and is refused with error 1280.
A direct construction with PRİMARY in the ordinary index identity is rejected by the same name obligation.
Index field spellings éLAN and ΆΛΦΑ resolve to their stored accented mixed-case identifiers, independently of the unaccented field elan.
Using élan and ÉLAN as separate fields of the same index is rejected with error 1060.
DROP INDEX PRİMARY removes the physically named PRIMARY, without changing two unrelated accented and unaccented secondary indexes.
codeConnection: Inspect the complete fixed PHP case table and strtr implementation. On valid UTF-8 BMP scalars the encoded keys cannot occur inside another scalar or overlap adjacent scalars, so whole-name replacement composes the scalar mapping without context-dependent decisions. Check the name resolver and case table byte identity against the installed distribution.
faults: Rewrite the declaration's stored output name.
Stop before exhausting the scalar domain.
